body: In Aotearoa you can often see a physiotherapist without a GP referral. A GP is a good next step if you’re unsure, unwell, or have other health conditions. Use ED or call 111 for emergencies. Healthline 0800 611 116 can advise 24/7.

soft_when_to_get_help.title: When to get help
soft_when_to_get_help.soon: See a physiotherapist or GP if pain is getting worse, messing with sleep or work, or not settling over a few weeks.
soft_when_to_get_help.now: Use the urgent list or Healthline if new red-flag symptoms appear.

soft_banner.title: Worth getting checked soon
soft_banner.body: Your answers don’t sound like an emergency from this checklist, but a physiotherapist or GP can assess you properly — especially if pain is lasting, worsening, or limiting daily life.
